meta.name: debrief
meta.description: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into sourced decisions, changes and next actions. Use after a customer conversation; review consequential record updates before saving.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把会议记录或转录整理成有出处的结论、变更和下一步行动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次开完客户会都要整理结论和后续行动
copy.tagline_en: Turn meeting notes into sourced decisions, changes and next actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must capture decisions and follow-ups after client calls

howto.what: 它把会议记录或转录稿整理成有出处的决定、变更和后续行动,并在保存重要的记录更新前先让你审核。若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前脱敏范围,不重跑设置。
howto.when: 在客户对话结束后使用。若这次由 @fde 调用,直接复用其当前脱敏范围,不再重启设置、发现或重复已回答的问题。

say.text: 把这次客户通话的记录整理成决定和后续行动。
say.note: 产出带出处的决定与行动项。

say.text: 保存前先给我看要改的客户记录。
say.note: 重要更新等你确认后才写入。

say.text: 复用 @fde 的脱敏范围继续这次 debrief。
say.note: 不重跑设置,接着往下做。

howto.what_en: It turns meeting notes or a transcript into sourced decisions, changes and next actions, and asks you to review consequential record updates before saving. When called by @fde it reuses that sanitized scope instead of restarting setup.
howto.when_en: Use it after a customer conversation. If @fde calls it, it reuses that current sanitized packet and scope rather than restarting setup, discovery or questions already answered.

say_en.text: Turn these customer call notes into decisions and next actions.
say_en.note: Produces decisions with sources and follow-ups.

say_en.text: Show me the record updates before you save them.
say_en.note: Consequential updates wait for your review.

say_en.text: Reuse the @fde sanitized scope and continue this debrief.
